standard_prerequisites.name: For a polynomial algebra E over R^G the invariants of E tensor_{R^G} R under G are exactly E
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the base case where the lemma applies.

standard_prerequisites.name: The invariants modulo the ideal generated by J behave as described by the invariants-modulo-bis lemma, giving the polynomial identities for the quotient
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the polynomial identities from E to A = E/J.

core_obligations: Choose a surjection E -> A with E a polynomial algebra over R^G; since E is a free R^G-module, the invariants (E tensor_{R^G} R)^G equal E (proof lines 32647-32649). Let J = Ker(E -> A); by right exactness of the tensor product, A tensor_{R^G} R is the quotient of E tensor_{R^G} R by the ideal generated by J (proof lines 32649-32652). The statement of the lemma for A is therefore the special case of the invariants-modulo-bis lemma with base algebra E and ideal J, which supplies the monic polynomial P with image (T - b)^n and the identity (T - a)^n = T^n (proof lines 32652-32653).
proof_roadmap: Present A as a quotient of a polynomial algebra E with trivial invariants (proof lines 32647-32649).
Describe A tensor R as a quotient and invoke the invariants-modulo-bis lemma (proof lines 32649-32653).
